Name: Sea-Dweller Deepsea
Description:
44mm – 2011 Model – Complete Set (Box & Papers)

A true first-generation Deepsea — the reference that redefined Rolex overengineering. This 2011 piece carries the full presence of the original 44mm titan.

Name: Air-King White Dial
Description: The Air-King 114200 — understated Rolex elegance with a clean 34mm Oyster case and crisp white dial. Perfect everyday Rolex.

Name: Sea-Dweller Classic
Description: The iconic 40mm Rolex Sea-Dweller 16600 — the last of the classic tool-watch Sea-Dwellers before the Deepsea era. Increasingly hard to find locally in this condition.

Name: Submariner Date Black
Description: The definitive modern dive watch. 41mm case with Cerachrom ceramic bezel, powered by caliber 3235 with 70-hour power reserve. Complete set.

Name: Cosmograph Daytona Panda
Description: The holy grail of modern sport chronographs. White dial with black Cerachrom bezel — the iconic 'Panda' configuration. Caliber 4130 in-house chronograph. Brand new, full set.

Name: GMT-Master II Batman
Description: The Batman GMT on Jubilee — blue-and-black Cerachrom bezel, caliber 3285 with 70-hour power reserve. The perfect blend of sportiness and elegance. Complete set.

Name: Nautilus Blue Dial
Description: The undisputed king of luxury sports watches. Discontinued 5711/1A with iconic blue dial and horizontal embossed pattern. 40mm stainless steel by Gérald Genta. Complete set.

Name: Aquanaut Black
Description: Patek's modern sporty icon. Embossed black dial, 40mm steel case, tropical composite strap resistant to UV and saltwater. Caliber 324 S C. Complete set.

Name: Calatrava White Gold
Description: Pure dress watch perfection. 37mm 18K white gold case, silver opaline dial with dauphine hands, ultra-thin caliber 215 PS manual-wind. Complete set.

Name: Royal Oak Blue Dial
Description: The modern evolution of Gérald Genta's most revolutionary design. 41mm with blue Grande Tapisserie dial, caliber 4302 automatic. Complete set in excellent condition.

Name: Royal Oak Offshore Chrono
Description: The original luxury sport chronograph. 42mm with Méga Tapisserie dial, flyback chronograph caliber 3126/3840. Rubber strap with titanium deployant. Box only.

Name: Santos de Cartier Medium
Description: The first-ever purpose-built wristwatch, originally designed in 1904 for aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont. SmartLink bracelet with quick-switch system. Caliber 1847 MC. Complete set.

Name: Tank Française Small
Description: A modern icon of refined elegance. 2023 redesign with slimmer proportions and seamlessly integrated bracelet. Silvered dial with blued-steel sword-shaped hands. Brand new, full set.

Name: Speedmaster Moonwatch
Description: The only watch qualified by NASA for all manned space missions. Latest generation with caliber 3861 co-axial master chronometer, retaining the iconic Hesalite crystal. Complete set.
